repair_contract: Each control and mathematical producer uses a newly created private child workspace; historical expected output is never staged there.
Declared producer result is absent immediately before execution; only fresh contained regular non-symlink unaliased output is accepted.
All authenticated source/reference bytes and file identities are checked after each child before any next child is allowed.
No shared generated dependencies: author and independent producers are self-contained and need no generated inputs from another run.
Preserve fresh actual raw output and subprocess failure diagnostics even when comparison or input authentication fails.
Reject output/input symlinks, ancestor symlinks, source aliases, nonregular results and protected overwrite destinations.
Preserve the exact original scientific schema and top-level runtime_seconds/python/sympy provenance-only separation.
Entry point and comparison execute the authenticated source bytes directly; timestamp-valid precompiled caches cannot replace sealed source execution.
Reject empty or invalid optimizer plans at the internal run_replay entry as well as the CLI; zero-child runs cannot claim a verification pass.
scope: Finite exact algebra and replay execution provenance only; no theorem-source changes, analytic recertification, BGS closure, commit or publication by this repair worker.
